description: This file contains implementation of static methods for QuicConfigPeer class, used for testing and setting various configuration parameters in the QUIC protocol.

classes.name: QuicConfigPeer
classes.description: A testing peer class providing static methods to set internal fields of QuicConfig for testing purposes.

methods.name: SetReceivedInitialStreamFlowControlWindow
methods.description: Sets the initial stream flow control window bytes in QuicConfig.

methods.name: SetReceivedInitialMaxStreamDataBytesIncomingBidirectional
methods.description: Sets the maximum stream data bytes for incoming bidirectional streams.

methods.name: SetReceivedInitialMaxStreamDataBytesOutgoingBidirectional
methods.description: Sets the maximum stream data bytes for outgoing bidirectional streams.

methods.name: SetReceivedInitialMaxStreamDataBytesUnidirectional
methods.description: Sets the maximum stream data bytes for unidirectional streams.

methods.name: SetReceivedInitialSessionFlowControlWindow
methods.description: Sets the initial session flow control window bytes.

methods.name: SetReceivedConnectionOptions
methods.description: Sets received connection options.

methods.name: SetReceivedBytesForConnectionId
methods.description: Sets the number of bytes for connection ID, with a check for valid values.

methods.name: SetReceivedDisableConnectionMigration
methods.description: Disables connection migration.

methods.name: SetReceivedMaxBidirectionalStreams
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of bidirectional streams.

methods.name: SetReceivedMaxUnidirectionalStreams
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of unidirectional streams.

methods.name: SetConnectionOptionsToSend
methods.description: Sets connection options to send.

methods.name: SetReceivedStatelessResetToken
methods.description: Sets the stateless reset token.

methods.name: SetReceivedMaxPacketSize
methods.description: Sets the maximum UDP payload size.

methods.name: SetReceivedMinAckDelayMs
methods.description: Sets the minimum acknowledgment delay in milliseconds.

methods.name: SetNegotiated
methods.description: Sets the negotiated flag.

methods.name: SetReceivedOriginalConnectionId
methods.description: Sets the original destination connection ID.

methods.name: SetReceivedInitialSourceConnectionId
methods.description: Sets the initial source connection ID.

methods.name: SetReceivedRetrySourceConnectionId
methods.description: Sets the retry source connection ID.

methods.name: SetReceivedMaxDatagramFrameSize
methods.description: Sets the maximum datagram frame size.

methods.name: SetReceivedAlternateServerAddress
methods.description: Sets the alternate server address based on IP family.

methods.name: SetPreferredAddressConnectionIdAndToken
methods.description: Sets the preferred address connection ID and token pair.
